sql:
SELECT mr.year, mr.driver_id, COUNT(*) as missed_count
FROM (
  SELECT arr.year, arr.race_id, arr.round, arr.driver_id, arr.constructor_id as drive_constructor_id
  FROM (
    SELECT r.year, r.race_id, r.round, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id
    FROM races r
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
      FROM drives
    ) d
    WHERE r.year = d.year AND r.round BETWEEN d.first_round AND d.last_round
  ) arr
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT r.year, r.race_id, r.round, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id as result_constructor_id
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  ) rr ON arr.year = rr.year AND arr.race_id = rr.race_id AND arr.driver_id = rr.driver_id
  WHERE rr.race_id IS NULL
) mr
GROUP BY mr.year, mr.driver_id
HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
